text_target: My head hurts a bit today.
phonetic: /maɪ hɛd hɜːrts ə bɪt təˈdeɪ/
text_native: J'ai un peu mal à la tête aujourd'hui.

text_target: I wash my face every morning.
phonetic: /aɪ wɒʃ maɪ feɪs ˈɛvri ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/
text_native: Je me lave le visage tous les matins.

text_target: Open your mouth and say ah.
phonetic: /ˈoʊpən jʊər maʊθ ənd seɪ ɑː/
text_native: Ouvre la bouche et dis ah.

text_target: She has very long brown hair.
phonetic: /ʃiː hæz ˈvɛri lɔːŋ braʊn hɛər/
text_native: Elle a de très longs cheveux chatains.

text_target: Wash your hands before eating.
phonetic: /wɒʃ jʊər hændz bɪˈfɔːr ˈiːtɪŋ/
text_native: Lave-toi les mains avant de manger.

text_target: He broke his arm playing football.
phonetic: /hiː broʊk hɪz ɑːrm ˈpleɪɪŋ ˈfʊtbɔːl/
text_native: Il s'est cassé le bras en jouant au foot.

text_target: My back is killing me after work.
phonetic: /maɪ bæk ɪz ˈkɪlɪŋ miː ˈæftər wɜːrk/
text_native: J'ai le dos en compote après le boulot.

text_target: Put on a jacket, your legs are cold.
phonetic: /pʊt ɒn ə ˈdʒækɪt, jʊər lɛɡz ɑːr koʊld/
text_native: Mets une veste, tu as froid aux jambes.

text_target: I cut my finger while cooking dinner.
phonetic: /aɪ kʌt maɪ ˈfɪŋɡər waɪl ˈkʊkɪŋ ˈdɪnər/
text_native: Je me suis coupé le doigt en préparant le dîner.

text_target: She listens to music with her headphones.
phonetic: /ʃiː ˈlɪsənz tuː ˈmjuːzɪk wɪð hɜːr ˈhɛdfoʊnz/
text_native: Elle écoute de la musique avec son casque.

text_target: My eyes get tired when I look at screens too long.
phonetic: /maɪ aɪz ɡɛt ˈtaɪərd wɛn aɪ lʊk æt skriːnz tuː lɔːŋ/
text_native: J'ai les yeux fatigués quand je regarde les écrans trop longtemps.

text_target: He hurt his knee during the morning run.
phonetic: /hiː hɜːrt hɪz niː ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ rʌn/
text_native: Il s'est fait mal au genou pendant son footing du matin.

text_target: Take a deep breath and relax your shoulders.
phonetic: /teɪk ə diːp brɛθ ənd rɪˈlæks jʊər ˈʃoʊldərz/
text_native: Prends une grande inspiration et détends tes épaules.

text_target: I have a terrible stomachache this morning.
phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə ˈtɛrəbəl ˈstʌməkˌeɪk ðɪs ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/
text_native: J'ai un affreux mal de ventre ce matin.

text_target: She wears a nice silver ring on her thumb.
phonetic: /ʃiː wɛrz ə naɪs ˈsɪlvər rɪŋ ɒn hɜːr θʌm/
text_native: Elle porte une jolie bague en argent au pouce.

text_target: My feet are sore after walking all day in town.
phonetic: /maɪ fiːt ɑːr sɔːr ˈæftər ˈwɔːkɪŋ ɔːl deɪ ɪn taʊn/
text_native: J'ai mal aux pieds à force de marcher toute la journée en ville.

text_target: He wiped the sweat from his forehead with a towel.
phonetic: /hiː waɪpt ðə swɛt frʌm hɪz ˈfɔːrhɛd wɪð ə ˈtaʊəl/
text_native: Il s'est essuyé la sueur du front avec une serviette.

text_target: Can you carry this heavy box on your shoulders?
phonetic: /kæn juː ˈkæri ðɪs ˈhɛvi bɒks ɒn jʊər ˈʃoʊldərz/
text_native: Tu peux porter ce carton lourd sur tes épaules ?

text_target: She smiled and showed her white teeth.
phonetic: /ʃiː smaɪld ənd ʃoʊd hɜːr waɪt tiːθ/
text_native: Elle a souri en montrant ses dents blanches.

text_target: Listen carefully to what your heart is telling you.
phonetic: /ˈlɪsən ˈkɛrfʊli tuː wʌt jʊər hɑːrt ɪz ˈtɛlɪŋ juː/
text_native: Écoute bien ce que ton cœur te dit.
